messages:
Noel Chen: hey everyone :wave: I'm Noel — started today as a runtime SWE. excited to be here! my main focus will be token routing and batching. pronouns he/him. fun fact: I make sourdough on weekends. any tips for first-week priorities?
Aisha Khan: welcome Noel! :tada: I'll be your onboarding buddy — ping me for anything. first-week checklist: laptop access, Slack perms, dev cluster creds, and a quick intro meeting.
Noel Chen: thanks Aisha — appreciate it. who should I ask about a dedicated GPU instance for local testing?
Benji Flores: @Noel Chen hi! for GPU access, open a ticket in #eng-infra with the template below or DM me. usually we provision a dev-gpu for 2 weeks.
Benji Flores: ```
Title: request dev GPU for <project>
Owner: <your name>
Reason: quick repro / E2E testing
Size: 1xA10G (or specify)
Duration: 2 weeks
```
Noel Chen: perfect, will do. laptop-wise — I'm on macOS; any setup tips or dotfiles I should grab?
Lena Ortiz: welcome! For macs we use the dev container flow mostly. clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-setup and run `./bootstrap.sh`. add SSH key to your GitHub and ping people-ops for Okta enroll.
Noel Chen: got it. any Slack channels I should lurk in?
Aisha Khan: #eng-runtime, #devex, #random (for memes), and #all-hands recap posts if you miss the meeting.
infra-bot: [system] created calendar invite: "Onboarding: Runtime team intro" — today 3:30pm PT (Zoom link in event).
people-ops-bot: [system] welcome Noel! Please fill out the new-hire form: https://hr.redwood.example/new-hire-form
Noel Chen: thanks infra-bot and people-ops! quick question: where do we keep runbooks and oncall docs?
Lena Ortiz: runbooks live in the eng-sre repo under docs/runbooks. for oncall rotation check the #eng-oncall channel and the rota spreadsheet (linked in pinned messages).
Benji Flores: also add this to your bookmarks: https://console.redwood.example/dashboard — token usage and model metrics are there.
Aisha Khan: small thing — team lunch on Friday at 12:30pm in the office kitchen. come if you're local!
Noel Chen: would love to, thanks. last Q: preferred way to ask for design reviews?
Lena Ortiz: open a PR and add `@eng-runtime` reviewers + add the tag "design-review" in the PR body. we try to keep reviews within 48 hours.
Noel Chen: amazing. thanks everyone :rocket: excited to get started!
Aisha Khan: :wave: see you at the intro meeting. I'll DM you a short onboarding doc with links and a checklist.
Benji Flores: ping me when you file the infra ticket, I'll watch for it.
people-ops-bot: [system] onboarding checklist status: 1/5 completed (account created).
Noel Chen: copying notes here so I don't forget. thanks all!
Lena Ortiz: welcome aboard Noel — small town tradition: bring sourdough next week? :wink:
